annotations.title: Get a free introduction request link

description: Get the link that starts a free request for pest control help in a US city. The request goes to one licensed company at a time, never to several at once and never resold, and the homeowner pays nothing at any point. This tool only builds and returns the link plus what happens next; it sends nothing and files nothing. The person has to open the link and agree to be contacted themselves, because US law requires that consent to be their own act and nobody can give it for them.

city.description: City where the help is needed, e.g. Houston. A city name only, never a street address.

pest.description: Optional pest type, e.g. termites, bed bugs, rodents. Defaults to general pest control.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: get_intro_request_link

consentNote.description: Why the person, not an assistant, has to send it

fullListAndFreeRequest.description: PestPin page with the full list of companies

listedCompanyCount.description: License-record companies PestPin can offer the request to

requestLink.description: Link the homeowner opens to send the request, or null when no company is listed there
